measures.definition: Counts of places mapped within 10 km of the centre (coworking, climbing, pools, hackerspaces, stations, cycle paths, green space).
Indoor climbing and bouldering gyms mapped in OpenStreetMap within 10 km of the centre.
Length of paths built or signed for bicycles, mapped in OpenStreetMap within 10 km of the centre; painted lanes on roads are not counted.
Share of the land within 10 km of the centre that is park, woodland, heath or other public green space in OpenStreetMap; the sea is left out of the land.
Community workshops for building things, mapped in OpenStreetMap within 10 km of the centre.
Train, metro and light-rail stations mapped in OpenStreetMap within 10 km of the centre.
Swimming centres and pools open to the public, mapped in OpenStreetMap within 10 km of the centre.

rights.edition: OpenStreetMap via the Overpass API, read 2026-10-27

fetch.rateLimit: public Overpass servers: two slots per client; minutes per city
